evidence.dominant_driver: Fed hike pricing reinforced by resilient US private domestic demand and energy-driven inflation risk

market_expectations.distribution_notes: A hike is already overwhelmingly priced; residual surprise is therefore limited unless policy guidance shifts further hawkish.

absorption.reason: The article summarizes data already known and a rate-hike expectation already heavily reflected in Treasury yields and equity weakness.

observed_reaction.US10Y: had already traded above 5% before easing

observations.DXY: firm near 99.6 in latest available context

evidence.decision_notes: Residual-move forecast only. This is not a fresh data release; the dominant hawkish information is already substantially priced. Latest cross-asset observations are not tick-level and confidence is capped accordingly.

immediate.rationale: Hawkish backdrop is bearish but already substantially priced.

next_session.rationale: FOMC event risk dominates after substantial pre-pricing.

15m.rationale: Low-novelty commentary is unlikely to create a clean new impulse.

1h.rationale: High yields and firm hike pricing remain a valuation headwind if yields stay elevated.

4h.rationale: Already-extended rate move raises reversal risk before the decision.

next_session.rationale: Near-fully priced hike makes guidance and yield reaction more important than the article.

predictions.mechanism: Higher discount rates pressure long-duration technology valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Sustained decline in Treasury yields and DXY with improving risk appetite.
predictions.counter_case: Because a hike is already heavily priced and US10Y faded from above 5%, yields could retrace and tech could rebound.

technical_state.extension_state: extended macro move / article low novelty

immediate.rationale: Rate pressure persists but much of the repricing preceded the article.

next_session.rationale: FOMC outcome and yield response dominate.

1h.rationale: Elevated yields and oil remain a broad valuation/inflation headwind.

4h.rationale: Absorption is high and yield retracement could offset hawkish pressure.

next_session.rationale: Near-full hike pricing limits residual directional edge.

predictions.mechanism: Higher yields compress equity multiples while oil sustains inflation concerns.
predictions.invalidation: US10Y falls decisively and oil risk premium contracts.
predictions.counter_case: Heavy pre-pricing can trigger a relief rally even if the Fed hikes as expected.

immediate.rationale: High yields and firm USD are bearish, but geopolitical/oil risk supports haven demand.

next_session.rationale: Conflicting rate and safe-haven forces remain.

15m.rationale: The hawkish information is old and gold faces opposing macro forces.

1h.rationale: If DXY and real-rate proxies stay firm, rate pressure should dominate.

4h.rationale: Geopolitical risk and possible yield retracement limit downside conviction.

next_session.rationale: FOMC guidance versus haven demand creates two-sided risk.

predictions.mechanism: Higher nominal/real yields and USD pressure gold while geopolitical stress supports it.
predictions.invalidation: Sharp fall in yields/DXY or renewed Middle East escalation.
predictions.counter_case: Any yield reversal or fresh Hormuz escalation can rapidly restore safe-haven buying.
